explanation_full: The analysis confirms that the KNN model is the best benchmark model, achieving an R2 score of 0.81717 and an RMSE of 0.11318. The model's performance is superior to all other tested algorithms, including RF (R2: 0.7756) and XGBoost (R2: 0.7495). Furthermore, the top three features correlated with HPR are VFA (0.7984), Butyrate (0.7827), and Acetate (0.7641), suggesting they are the most critical inputs for predicting HPR.
